economic_rationale: Ikenberry (1995) post-buyback-announcement underreaction drift, constructed as an EVENT-TIME continuous signal via DART tsstkAqDecsn (board treasury-acquisition DECISIONS). Hypothesis: hold announcing firms in a post-decision drift window, ranked by buyback intensity (planned_amount/Size, direct-method). EMPIRICAL RESULT: the KR buyback-decision catalyst has NO positive post-disclosure drift at the decision level (event-vs-market −0.43%/mo, NW-t −0.88) and the intensity tilt is PERVERSE (largest buybacks underperform, D10 −1.78%/mo). The drift is salient/mandatory disclosure (efficiently priced by announcement day) and recent (2023+ Value-up) buyback-decision firms behave as already-run-up names that mean-revert.

factor_specs.lag_rule: rcept_dt PIT announcement; Usable_Date = rcept_date + 1 trading day (C2)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Ikenberry buyback underreaction drift, event-time. EMPIRICALLY NEGATIVE in KR.

concentration_tests.event_vs_market_verdict: The Ikenberry base case (pure announcement drift, all event firms EW) is FLAT-to-NEGATIVE in KR. The catalyst itself has no positive post-decision drift — full stop (honest_risk primary failure mode realized).
concentration_tests.size_verdict: NOT a micro-cap artifact — negative survives (does not flip positive) in liquid large names. Real (negative) effect, not noise.

orthogonality.verdict: Orthogonal to FF5+WML factor RETURN series (max |corr| 0.16 vs WML). NOVELTY UNVERIFIED — the spec's binding cross-sectional redundancy checks (vs Net-Payout-Yield, C23 OtherCorp, value/EP, Size, INV flow, insider) were NOT run at the cross-sectional score level (no cached net-payout score loaded). The proposer's novelty=5 claim is therefore NOT confirmed by this WT. Active-return FF orthogonality is suggestive but insufficient to assert a novel channel.
orthogonality.ortho_caveat: Codex critic C3 ACCEPTED. Cross-sectional net-payout/C23 redundancy is the single most important novelty test per spec and was not executed. Because the realized alpha is negative, the practical consequence of leaving novelty unverified is limited (a negative signal is not deployed whether novel or redundant) — but the package does NOT make a novelty claim, and any future revival of this concept must run the cross-sectional redundancy battery first.

era_breakdown.verdict: The negative is overwhelmingly a 2023+ Value-up-surge phenomenon (SR −0.92). Pre-2023 is flat (no positive drift either). KR buyback-decision firms 2023+ behave as crowded/run-up names that mean-revert post-disclosure.
